notes.title: v1.36: Fixes and new stuff
notes.notes:
v1.35:
- Bug with blocking crosses not disappeared fixed
- Summoning witch demon won't affect on clearing floor reward in dungeon
- Achievements should work properly
- Bug with no place for summon/teleporting mob when there is some place fixed 
- Bug with meat text becoming small fixed
- Descriptions of bard skills improved 
v1.36:
-bug with one of the block effects ( arrows ) fixed
-bug with rare crashes with bard fixed

- Amount of block effects in the dungeons reduced
- New item added "Book of diffusion" - allows to dispel all active block effects
- Wicked Eye artifact improved - all block effects will dispel faster.
-The Goddess give more buffs in the ACT III

Hot fix:
Achievements of the ACT III  about killing different monsters fixed. 


New stuff:

Dungeon block effects. Now some blocks in dungeon could be affected by some events. Be careful : )

Trading cards will be added soon : )

notes.title: v1.34: Fixes for sounds, achievements and more
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/3wegiYp.png[/img]

Hi everyone! Pixeye is pumping out updates, and here's the latest and greatest from v1.34:
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug with block cross appearing near archers after transforming them into sheep and killing an enemy
[*]The Sharp Stones bug is now fixed
[*]Esc button works properly 
[*]Fixed issues with some sounds playing when muted
[*] Achievements for finishing chapters now work properly (will work if you start a new game)
[/list]

Keep those reports coming, happy dungeon crawling!

notes.title: Dungelot: Shattered Lands v1.33 update.
notes.notes:
- Added hotkeys : 
  [list]
    [*] 1-4 to activate skills
    [*]	C to craft
     [*]	I to inventory
    [*]	Esc to menu
   [*]Space to skip dialog ( dialog also skip-able with mouse click )
[/list]
- Fixed bug with sharp stones they now load properly after a loaded save.
- Fixed bug with flow blocking dungeon blocks
- Fixed exploit with infinite bomb crafting 
- Fixed bug with mansion oil not giving bombs the bonus
- Fixed bug with growing red cross
- Updated crossbow is a 1h weapon now
- Updated sharp stones can be used in packs instead by 1
- Updated blacksmith is activated by clicking mouse not spacebar
- Updated the main menu
- Update Vampire's Dark Hit  description 
- Updated Twitch Version
- item added - Dragonskin armor

notes.title: v1.32: Bug fixes & optimizations
notes.notes:
We're working super hard on updating Dungelot: Shattered Lands, here's the changelog for v1.32 (day 1 patch, woo!) 

- Fixed tons of bugs with coins
- Fixed tons of bugs with menus
- Fixed occasional crash in the hideout
- No more overlapping menus

Do let us know on the forum or in the comments if you're experiencing issues. We found out last-minute that on certain video cards the fonts don't render, so that was a fun fix. 

Happy dungeon crawling!

notes.title: Welcome to Dungelot: Shattered Lands!
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/LvaIho0.gif[/img]

Hello adventurer, and welcome to Dungelot: Shattered Lands. 

If you got here because of the Twitch 100 Level Challenge, be mindful that the full game features much more than a roguelike mode. It starts off with a full story and multiple playable characters. Once you beat a chapter, you can play that chapter in Endless Mode. 

We've worked really hard on this, and hope you enjoy as much as we do.

Good luck. 

You'll need it.

notes.title: First update adds tons of changes
notes.notes:
Hi all! The first iteration of the beta gave us tons of feedback. 

Here's the changelog

- added sfx/music controls
- you can now reassign your last used skill points
- mansion moved one level further
- added additional messages when you got into the first dungeon
- rebalanced prices
- highlighted what and and can't be bought in the mansion
- no more than 2 archers on levels now
- progress indicator per dungeon

- main thing is graves, places where you died previously now become their own spaces similar to taverns
- gives you a random perma-increase when you reach it

Please share feedback on the new experience
